display_long_description:
Step onto the pitch and experience the pressure of every shot in Firstkick VR Soccer, the most immersive VR soccer game built for Meta Quest and Meta Quest 3.

Choose how you want to play:

Shootout Mode puts you behind the ball in this fast-paced VR soccer simulator. Pick your target, line up the shot, and try to beat the goalkeeper. Improve your aim, timing, and finishing as you chase cleaner, more accurate strikes.

Goalkeeper Mode puts you between the posts. Read the shot, react quickly, and make the save. Test your reflexes and positioning as you defend the goal against incoming attempts in this realistic Meta Quest soccer experience.

Whether you prefer scoring goals or stopping them, Firstkick VR Soccer delivers quick, easy-to-jump-into VR football action from both sides of the penalty area. Practice your shooting, sharpen your goalkeeping reactions, and enjoy the feeling of being on the pitch in virtual reality soccer.

Features:

● Realistic VR soccer gameplay built for Meta Quest
● Free kick shootout-style shooting action
● Goalkeeper mode with reaction-based saves
● Skill-focused aiming, timing, accuracy, and reflexes
● Play as both the shooter and the goalkeeper
● Optimized VR football experience for Meta Quest 3

Take your first kick, defend your goal, and see how you perform under pressure in the ultimate VR soccer game.
